artifacts.rights_basis: The exact Salesian printing dated 24 February 1930 and the 1922 Tours Mame printing are public domain in the United States by elapsed publication-date term. The entire Secret petition is independently witnessed in the 1930 source. Its historical Per Dominum cue and the separately retained literal Mame Father-directed formula support the actual target conclusion prefix ending in unitate. No modern lexical petition contribution is used; declared orthography, pointing and line-wrap changes add no authorship to the received words. Project editorial layout alone is offered under CC BY 4.0; underlying received Latin is excluded. The 1962 facsimile supplies text-free target comparison only. No whole modern edition or image is cleared.
